= CIM Modeling in ProCloud Server
:sectnums:
This guide is primarilly for UCAiug CIM TF 13, TF 14, and TF16 model managers (CIM MMs). If you have questions, please reach out to a CIM MM.

== Starting Point for Making Model Changes

In the official repository, we store multiple versions of the CIM model, for all to access. It is important to make sure you know what version of the model you are intending to edit. 

For Public Use:

* CIM100
* CIM101
* CIM102

For Development:

* DEV100
* DEV101
* Grid:
** DEV101_Grid
* Enterprise:
** https://ucatf.org/tf14/tf14-parts/?wpcp_%3D[Enterprise starting point for 14v04]
** DEV101_Part11 Enterprise 14v04
** DEV101_Part11 Enterprise 14v05
** DEV101_Part11 Enterprise 14v06
** DEV101 Enterprise 14v06
* Market:
** DEV101_Market
* DEV102


For others not listed here, we recommend going to...
